newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Defence Minister Charles Millon says planned defence sector restructuring will not include forced redundancies.

-- British Airways considers bidding for insolvent domestic airline Air Liberte, would increase market share in France and may hold up to 20 percent of take-off and landing slots at Orly airport. British group Virgin may also be interested, while French government wants a French bidder.
-- Credit Lyonnais needs a state recapitalisation estimated around eight or nine billion francs, to improve its Cooke solvency ratio in order to be privatised.
